page_title: NOT 1-0 TOT | Nottingham Forest v Tottenham Hotspur 26/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nottingham.
90+4' Djed Spence (Tottenham) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
90+3' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
90+3' Jota Silva (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Tottenham.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared by the defence.
87' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Yves Bissouma.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Callum Hudson-Odoi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ramon Sosa (Nottingham).
87' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Chris Wood and he is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
85' Jota Silva (Nottingham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Craig Pawson no option but to blow his whistle.
82' Substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White makes his way off the pitch and Jota Silva (Nottingham) comes on as his replacement.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Elliot Anderson can be given a rest.
81' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Heung-Min Son is replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Destiny Udogie will be replaced by Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
80' Tottenham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
79' The attendance is 30200.
77' James Maddison (Tottenham) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
75' The referee is firm and issues Djed Spence (Tottenham) a deserved yellow card.
74' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Anthony Elanga will be replaced by Morato (Nottingham).
73' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Craig Pawson signals a foul.
71' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
66' The referee blows his whistle as Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
65' Murillo (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
64' Substitution. James Maddison (Tottenham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pape Matar Sarr walks off.
64' Here is a change. Rodrigo Bentancur is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham).
62' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Chris Wood (Nottingham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

57' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Matz Sels, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
57' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
57' There's an opportunity for Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
57' The ball is cleared after Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.
56' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
54' The corner by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
53' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham)! That was a huge opportunity!
53' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Fraser Forster intercepts the ball.
51' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call.
50' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
49' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
47' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
43' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
41' The resulting corner, taken by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), comes to nothing.
40' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

39' Matz Sels pulls off a great save to deny Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
39' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
37' Ola Aina (Nottingham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
36' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:4. 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
31' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

28' 1 - 0 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White displays great vision and sends a pass to Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.

26' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
25' Tottenham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player. The possession of the ball – 33:67.
21' Chris Wood (Nottingham) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
20' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
17' Neat passing move from Tottenham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Tottenham couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Matz Sels (Nottingham) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
16' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
14' A player from Nottingham takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
10' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
8' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
8' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement.
7' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
6' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nottingham was in an offside position.
5' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Matz Sels.
3' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
2' Nottingham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nottingham will kick the game off.
